name: acp-hub-for-copilot
description: A local server that serves your Claude, Codex and Antigravity ACP agents as OpenAI-compatible models for Copilot CLI, Copilot Chat in VS Code and any other client, with one page to install, sign in, configure and monitor them.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agent Hub runs agent processes and requires a trusted workspace.

acpHub.server.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: How many minutes the ACP Hub server may go unused before it closes itself and its agents. Any open window counts as use, so this only applies once every window is closed. `0` keeps it running until you run `ACP Hub: Stop Server`. Applies the next time the server starts.

acpHub.server.detached.description: Run the ACP Hub server outside VS Code, so it survives closing or reloading a window and shows in Task Manager as its own process tree. Turn it off to tie the server to the window that started it. Its output goes to `server.log` in the ACP Hub store folder. Applies the next time the server starts.

acpHub.server.autoStart.description: Start the ACP Hub server when this window loads, and whenever the sidebar or a model list looks for one. Turn it off to start the server only when you ask for it: a chat message, the sidebar's **Start server** button, or `node <extensions folder>/dist/server.js` in a terminal. A running server is used either way; this only decides whether a window starts one by itself. Applies after a window reload.

scripts.test:smoke: npm run compile && node esbuild.js --tests && vscode-test
